style.vernacular: Dense sand-coloured city: 6-12 storey concrete-frame apartment blocks infilled with brick, often unrendered red brick or dusty beige render with flat roofs cluttered with water tanks, dishes and laundry; Khedival-era Haussmann-style downtown blocks in cream stone with iron balconies; Mamluk and Ottoman limestone mosques with banded stonework; modern gated compounds and malls in beige stone and glass.
style.ornament: Mashrabiya timber lattice screens and projecting balconies; muqarnas cornices and keel arches on Mamluk stonework; ablaq (alternating dark and light) banded masonry; Khedival neoclassical pediments and iron balcony rails; pharaonic revival motifs (lotus, cavetto cornice) on 1950s-60s monuments.

sources.what: multi-storey stone khans/wikalas around courtyards with shops below, ornate stone gates
Mamluk stone construction, muqarnas cornice, banded stone and marble
Khedival neoclassical downtown with a pinkish-beige facade
Khedival French-influenced palace architecture
